review_kind: independent manual screenshot and static source review

new_findings.title: Cross-chapter recovery labels do not identify their chapters
new_findings.evidence: The displayed session is chapter c01 page 1 and the failed retry target is chapter c02 page 1. The title and both recovery actions identify only page 1, so their two different chapter destinations are not visible.
new_findings.suggestion: Include chapter identity in the failure title and recovery destinations when the retry chapter differs from the displayed chapter. Keep same-chapter recovery concise.
new_findings.disposition: Root accepted the suggestion for candidate 3; candidate 2 remains the before evidence.

new_findings.title: Fullscreen reveals horizontal joins in the second bundled comic page
new_findings.evidence: The page-35 screenshot contains obvious repeated strips near screenshot rows 45 and 652. Direct inspection of the bundled source image shows the same top repeat and duplicated lower speech bubble near source rows 92 and 1304. These are source-image joins, not a containment or renderer defect. The former menu covered the affected areas; default fullscreen exposes them.
new_findings.suggestion: Repair the bundled page artwork without changing the viewport, fitting, renderer or genuine comic content.
new_findings.disposition: Root accepted a source-asset repair for candidate 3. The before artifact and hash are retained. The first geometry-only repair removed the repeated strips and split speech bubble, but Root found a subtle upper-panel tone boundary that the initial independent preview missed. The tone-corrected complete image and top crop were subsequently viewed: the gray background now appears continuous, with no further visible issue. Candidate 3 application captures remain required.

source_repair_preflight.tone_evidence_note: The first top-boundary-analysis copy retained first-version measurements. It was subsequently regenerated with predecessor, first-pass and tone-fixed fields and the SHA-256 of all three images. The final tone-fixed gap samples at rows 85 through 92 are reported as gray value 221, rather than treating the old first-pass data as final evidence.
source_repair_preflight.reported_unchanged_core_clip: The remote repair report records zero mismatched pixels in the original [0,92,1172,1304) clip, unchanged 1172 by 1648 dimensions and sixteen gray levels. These calculations were read, not rerun locally.

The desktop lifecycle baseline and resumed pair both retain page 20 and two image jobs started. The double-tap reset ends at its intended page 13 with zoom 1; the cancelled seek ends at page 12. These desktop observations are not native park evidence.
